channel.title: Noty
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
Let a note be pinned so nothing implicit closes it

A pinned note ignores everything the user did not aim at it: clicking away in
another app, and the idle timeout. Esc, Close, archive and delete still work,
since those are deliberate.

- New `pinned` column, added by a checked migration rather than an
attempt-and-ignore, so a real failure still surfaces in the log.
- Pin in the note header, ⌘P, and a Pin item on the tab's context menu.
- Pinned tabs carry a dot, and the flag persists.
